question: Does starting an AI Studio GPU notebook require a 实名认证 step with an ID document, and which documents does it accept?
why: No first-party page states it: the AI Studio notebook, FAQ and user-agreement pages describe the notebook flow without a real-name step, the real-name page answers 'This operation requires login', and only third-party reviews report an ID card. The registration form asks for a phone number from a country selector and no identity document. Settling it needs an account that completes the post-login 实名认证 page; Baidu Cloud's real-name pages list the mainland ID, the HK/Macau/Taiwan travel permit, the foreigner permanent residence permit and the passport of a Chinese citizen settled abroad, but no AI Studio page read ties those to the GPU gate.
